pages.text: Your race is chosen once at character creation and $(bold)cannot be changed.$() Races provide stat modifiers and thematic traits that stack with your origin and class.$(br2)The interaction between race and class is where build identity comes from. The same class played by two different races has a meaningfully different feel.

Night power. Sunlight weak.$(li)$(bold)Faefolk$() — Fast, magic-focused, fragile.$(li)$(bold)Demi-God$() — Massive HP, phase, fire weakness.$(li)$(bold)Ryu$() — Dragon-blooded, 25% DR, slow fall.$(li)$(bold)Fallen Angel$() — +15% damage, -20% HP.$(li)$(bold)Kirin$() — Fastest race, wall climb, fragile.
